Generally the HUD for in battle is /grpdat/cockpit while general ui for anything else you'd like to edit is just in the main grpdat folder. (Announce is round intros/winners)(Vs is obviously versus ui and ani) All my edits are gonna assume you arent bottom of the barrel braincells just saying ahead of time especially on the simple stuff like THIS!

'''Editing battle HUD'''
Go to the cockpit folder and have a dds editor.... THATS IT! chara folders store the character hud icons and the base cockpit folder is the rest of the gauges and such.
